Write a 900-word post for the engineering blog arguing that a team's roadmap should be a file in the repo, checked by the build. Use these three facts: our last three retrospectives found the checked-in plans survived and the wiki plans died; after we added a script that fails the build when a version bumps without a plan edit (March 2024), stale plan entries went from eleven to zero in a month; the usual objection is that a forced edit is a thoughtless edit. Audience: engineers who have watched a quarter's plan evaporate. End on the rule, not on a call to action.
